author: sdmine29
body: I was playing today on DTM when I started lagging. I guess someone thought i was hacking. But with auto-sneak? no. thats why i was banned  and it sucks because this is my favorite server. I also saw someone get banned for "regen" when I killed him with a bow 3 times. I forget his name but if anything comes up I hope I helped.

title: Appealing an infraction.

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately, I have decided to deny your appeal because you have not put enough detail, or effort into it. In addition, your ban is quite recent, and without any proof that your ban is false, it will not be appealed until you have served a significant amount of time being banned.

Regards,

Jinn, Avicus Network Administrator.
